item.title: Refactor order status strings to OrderStatus enum
item.brief:
Refactor the orders crate order status from String to a typed enum.

Requirements:
- Add src/status.rs with pub enum OrderStatus { Pending, Paid, Shipped, Cancelled }, deriving at least Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash.
- Implement OrderStatus::as_str(self) -> &'static str returning exactly the lowercase strings pending, paid, shipped, cancelled, and Display printing those same strings.
- Implement FromStr for OrderStatus with Err = ParseStatusError. ParseStatusError must be public, implement std::error::Error, and its message must name the rejected input.
- Implement OrderStatus::can_transition_to(self, next: OrderStatus) -> bool for exactly pending->paid, pending->cancelled, paid->shipped, paid->cancelled; all other pairs false.
- Change Order::status to OrderStatus, re-export OrderStatus and ParseStatusError from crate root, and use the enum everywhere so status string literals appear only in src/status.rs.
- Preserve observable behavior, including existing errors, report output and ordering, and parsing behavior.

Run cargo test and ensure it passes. Commit the completed work on the local item branch; do not push.

Acceptance: the enum API and transitions match the specified contract; status literals occur only in src/status.rs; existing observable behavior is preserved; cargo test passes; a commit is created.
